prompt: Create an original 60 second instrumental funk instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: clavinet, slap bass, tight drums, rhythm guitar. Style: sixteenth-note syncopation with short call-and-response riffs. Tempo approximately 106 BPM; D major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A relaxed, acoustic-leaning instrumental piece featuring a clean electric guitar melody over a steady bassline and light, brushed percussion. The guitar has a warm, slightly jazzy tone, creating a smooth and mellow atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首轻松、偏原声的器乐曲，以干净的电吉他旋律为主，配以稳定的贝斯线和轻柔的刷奏打击乐。吉他音色温暖，略带爵士风味，营造出流畅而柔和的氛围。
